steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Point: Sentence variety is essential for AO6 marks. Writing that uses only one sentence type feels monotonous and shows limited technical control. Varied sentences create rhythm, pace, and impact. | Short Sentences = Impact: A short sentence after several long ones stands out. It hits the reader harder because it's surrounded by more complex structures. | FANBOYS - Coordinating Conjunctions: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So | Subordinating Conjunctions: Because, although, when, while, if, since, before, after, unless, as, though, whereas

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What is the difference between a simple, compound, and complex sentence? | Name three ways to vary sentence openings. | When would you use short sentences in your writing?

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Key Point, Short Sentences = Impact, FANBOYS - Coordinating Conjunctions, and one past-paper question.
